title: headwater-method-import-set/1
description: What `headwater method import-set --json` prints: the normalisation and weighting set written beside its method. Example: `headwater method import-set toy-nw.csv --method toy-impacts --id toy-nw --version 1 --source "toy numbers" --unit Pt --json`.

unit.description: The unit of weighted scores and of the single score. Null for a set with no weights.

method.description: The method the set is for, pinned by its hash.

steps.description: What the set does: `normalised`, `weighted`, or both.

indicators.description: The ids of the indicators the set adds.

left_out.description: The indicators of the method the set has no row for: they count in none of its scores.
